meta.name: scope
meta.description: Assess a new customer request against agreed scope, trade-offs and ownership. Use when an engagement expands or a custom feature needs a commitment decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把客户临时加的需求对照既定范围,判断接不接、代价多大、由谁负责。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户常在项目中途加需求,你需要快速判断接不接、代价多大。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a mid-project client ask into a clear yes, no, or trade-off.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if clients keep adding requests mid-project and you need a fast scope call.

howto.what: 当你提出一个新的客户需求时,它会对照已约定的范围、取舍和归属做评估,帮你判断要不要给出承诺。它直接基于已有上下文工作,不重启已完成的设置,也不重复已答过的问题。
howto.when: 当项目范围扩大,或有定制功能需要做出承诺决定时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前的数据包与范围,不重启设置或调研。

say.text: 客户又提了个新需求,帮我对一下是否还在约定范围内
say.note: 会对照已约定的范围与取舍给出评估

say.text: 这个定制功能我们要不要承诺?帮我列出取舍和归属
say.note: 输出承诺决策所需的取舍与归属分析

say.text: 按 @fde 现有的数据包评估,别重跑设置
say.note: 复用当前数据包与范围继续评估

howto.what_en: When you bring a new customer request, it assesses it against agreed scope, trade-offs and ownership to help you decide on a commitment. It works from the context already supplied and won't restart setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an engagement expands or a custom feature needs a commitment decision. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: A customer just asked for this new thing — check it against our agreed scope
say_en.note: Assesses it against agreed scope and trade-offs

say_en.text: Should we commit to this custom feature? List the trade-offs and ownership
say_en.note: Gives the trade-offs and ownership for the decision

say_en.text: Assess using the existing @fde packet; don't rerun setup
say_en.note: Reuses the current packet and scope
